scope: Older 32-bit Windows voices, such as NeoSpeech Paul, Kate and James, now work in Voice Companion.

topics.title: Older 32-bit voices
details: Some older voices only work in 32-bit programs. NeoSpeech Paul, Kate and James are examples.
Before, Companion could not see them. Now they are in the voice list with your other voices.
Choose one in Options, or say use voice Paul.
Speed, volume, pause and stop work the same as with any other voice.
If one of these voices cannot start, Companion uses another voice and tells you.

topics.title: Voice check
details: Say Voice check to hear how many voices Companion can use.
It now runs in the background, so Companion keeps listening while it checks.
The report also lists the older 32-bit voices.
